affiliations.date_precision: The Army record carries an 18 August 1942 entry date; the actual work dates and temporal relationship to OSS service are unestablished.
affiliations.research_notes: The official Army entry records a broad occupational group but names no employer, workplace or employment dates. It is not converted into an immediate pre-OSS affiliation or last civilian employer.

claims.claim_text: Chester Christian has a high-confidence identifier-backed Army record match.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier and exact indexed name match an Army entry dated 18 August 1942 whose grade field reads private.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact indexed name plus exact private identifier; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry date establishes a wartime observation but not the date or route of later OSS service.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is masked publicly. The original index spelling and number remain unchanged.

claims.claim_text: The Army entry records the occupational group ‘Mechanics and repairmen, motor vehicle.’
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-backed Army record carries occupation code 781, which the inspected NARA code page labels Mechanics and repairmen, motor vehicle.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact indexed name plus exact private identifier; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: Observed with an Army entry date of 18 August 1942; temporal relationship to OSS entry remains uncertain.
claims.match_notes: No named employer, workplace, specific job title or employment date is inferred from the occupational group.
